root_idea.summary: The root has two principal semantic axes: occupying or diverting someone from one matter by another, and throwing or putting something by hand into an opening.
root_idea.development: The first axis yields meanings of distraction, diversion, amusement, and becoming occupied or heedless. The second extends to the mill-feed or mill opening, the uvula, and figuratively a gift.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Quranic headword تَلَهَّىٰ.
Displayed as the Form IV causative verb أَلْهَىٰ.
Displayed under the normalized singular active-participle citation form لَاهٍ.

senses.definition: To divert oneself or become occupied with something, with resulting distraction.
senses.usage_conditions: A self-directed or reflexive use describing the subject's becoming distracted or turning attention away.

senses.definition: To divert, distract, or occupy someone, drawing the person's attention away from another concern.
senses.usage_conditions: A transitive causative construction; the diverting cause may be a thing or an activity, including an activity such as singing.

senses.definition: Distracted or heedless, with attention occupied away from its proper concern.
senses.usage_conditions: An active-participle adjective; the Quranic occurrence is the feminine form describing a state of inward distraction.

senses.definition: Diversion, amusement, pastime, sport, or play that occupies a person away from another concern.
senses.usage_conditions: A noun for diversionary occupation; Quranic contexts use it for activities such as amusement, pastime, or sport, without requiring one particular type of activity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become diverted from something and consequently forget it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported with عَنْ in the construction لَهِيَ عَنْهُ; لَهَا عَنْهُ is also reported.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become cheered, delighted, and pleased by someone's discourse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in constructions such as لَهَتْ إِلَى حَدِيثِهِ and لَهَوْتُ بِحَدِيثِهِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An instrument of diversion, especially a musical instrument.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An object used for diversion; musical instruments are given as the characteristic application.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The uvula or the farthest part of the mouth; in a camel, the corresponding throat sac or شِقْشِقَة.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical noun with variant descriptions referring to the hanging flesh, the rear of the mouth, or the analogous camel anatomy.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The quantity of grain thrown by hand into a mill's opening, and also the mouth or opening of the millstone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical term for the hand-fed material or the receiving opening of a mill.
